# Da Nocdf Directory

**Author:** M. El Aabaribaoune

## Purpose
Harmonized ET products evaluated on the common GLEAM support.

## Contents
- GLEAM native reference.
- Noah-MP ET aggregated to the 0.1-degree GLEAM grid.

## Conventions
- Uses exact spherical overlap-area weighting.
- Temporal support: daily 2016-2020.
- Evaluated on the common evaluation support.

For detailed methodology, refer to `../../docs/preprocessing/value_data_preparation.md`.
**Important:** Files in this directory are generated by project scripts. Do NOT manually modify generated NetCDF products. Regenerate through the corresponding preprocessing script.
